🔍 What agents can do today

An Agent runs inside a single chat thread (the one you launch it in).

It can pull from uploaded files in that thread, or from connected apps (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, etc.).

It can also follow instructions you give it to query Supabase, Sheets, or other APIs you’ve connected.

❌ What it cannot do right now

Agents cannot crawl across all of your past ChatGPT chats automatically. Each thread is isolated for privacy and safety.
